decompress_inputs.description: Decompress FASTA and GTF files from gzip to plain text format for indexing.

fastp.name: fastp
fastp.description: Perform quality trimming and adapter removal for paired-end FASTQ reads.
fastp.run:
try:
    shell("""
        mkdir -p run_output/fastp/{wildcards.sample}
        /home/wjcmellon/fastp \
            -i {input.r1} \
            -I {input.r2} \
            -o {output.r1} \
            -O {output.r2} \
            --adapter_sequence AGATCGGAAGAG \
            --qualified_quality_phred 28 \
            --length_required 30 \
            --thread {threads}
        touch {output.done}
    """)
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "processing", "failed")
    raise e

build_bowtie2_index.description: Build Bowtie2 genome index from decompressed FASTA.

remove_rrna.name: remove_rrna
remove_rrna.description: Remove rRNA reads using Bowtie2 alignment.
remove_rrna.run:
try:
    shell("""
        mkdir -p run_output/rrna/{wildcards.sample}
        source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
        module load bowtie2

        bowtie2 -x {params.index_prefix} \
            -1 {input.r1} -2 {input.r2} \
            --no-unal --omit-sec-seq \
            --threads {threads} --mm --seed 1337 --time \
            --un-conc-gz run_output/rrna/{wildcards.sample}_no_rRNA.fastq.gz \
            2> run_output/rrna/{wildcards.sample}_no_rRNA.log

        touch {output.done}
    """)
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "processing", "failed")
    raise e

build_star_index.name: build_star_index
build_star_index.description: Build STAR genome index using decompressed FASTA and GTF files.
build_star_index.run:
try:
    shell("""
        source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
        module load star/2.7.10a
        mkdir -p {params.star_dir}

        STAR --runThreadN {threads} \
             --runMode genomeGenerate \
             --genomeDir {params.star_dir} \
             --genomeFastaFiles {input.fasta} \
             --sjdbGTFfile {input.gtf} \
             --sjdbOverhang 99

        touch {output.done}
    """)
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "processing", "failed")
    raise e

star_align.name: star_align
star_align.run:
try:
    shell("""
        source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
        module load star
        mkdir -p run_output/alignment/{wildcards.sample}
        rm -rf /tmp/star_tmp_{wildcards.sample}

        STAR --runThreadN {threads} \
             --genomeDir {input.index} \
             --genomeLoad NoSharedMemory \
             --readFilesIn {input.r1} {input.r2} \
             --readFilesCommand gunzip -c \
             --outFileNamePrefix run_output/alignment/{wildcards.sample}/{wildcards.sample}_ \
             --outReadsUnmapped Fastx \
             --outSAMattributes NH HI AS nM NM MD jM jI XS \
             --outSJfilterOverhangMin 15 15 15 15 \
             --outFilterMultimapNmax 20 \
             --outFilterScoreMin 1 \
             --outFilterMatchNminOverLread 0.7 \
             --outFilterMismatchNmax 999 \
             --outFilterMismatchNoverLmax 0.05 \
             --alignIntronMin 20 \
             --alignIntronMax 1000000 \
             --alignMatesGapMax 1000000 \
             --alignSJoverhangMin 15 \
             --alignSJDBoverhangMin 10 \
             --alignSoftClipAtReferenceEnds No \
             --chimSegmentMin 15 \
             --chimScoreMin 15 \
             --chimScoreSeparation 10 \
             --chimJunctionOverhangMin 15 \
             --sjdbGTFfile {input.gtf} \
             --quantMode GeneCounts \
             --twopassMode Basic \
             --chimOutType Junctions SeparateSAMold \
             --outTmpDir run_output/alignment/{wildcards.sample}/star_tmp

        touch {output.done}
    """)
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "processing", "failed")
    raise e

detect.name: detect
detect.run:
try:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "detect", "running")
    shell("""
        source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
        module unload circtools || true
        module load circtools/2.0.3

        circtools detect @{input.samplesheet} -ss -T {threads} -an {input.annotation} -A {input.reference} -B @{input.bamlist} -D -M -G -Nr {params.Nr1} {params.Nr2} -O ./run_output/circtools_ci -k

        awk 'BEGIN {FS=OFS="\t"} NR==FNR {key=$1 FS $2 FS $3; gene[key]=$4; next} FNR==1 {print "Gene", $0; next} {key=$1 FS $2 FS $3; g=(key in gene)?gene[key]:"not_annotated"; print g, $0}' run_output/circtools_ci/CircCoordinates run_output/circtools_ci/CircRNACount > run_output/circtools_ci/CircRNACountName.txt

        touch {output.done}
    """)
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "detect", "completed")
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "detect", "failed")
    raise e

build_ciriquant_filelist.name: build_ciriquant_filelist
build_ciriquant_filelist.description: Generate a file listing all CIRIquant outputs for each sample.
build_ciriquant_filelist.run:
with open(output[0], 'w') as out:
    for sample in config['samples'].keys():
        ciri_file = Path(f"run_output/ciriquant/{sample}/circ/{sample}.ciri").resolve()
        out.write(f"{sample}\t{ciri_file}\n")

metatool.name: metatool
metatool.description: Run Circtools MetaTool to merge and normalize circRNA and linear counts.
metatool.run:
try:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "metatool", "running")

    shell("""
        source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
        module unload circtools || true
        module load circtools/2.0.3
        mkdir -p {params.outdir}

        cp {input.circ_count} {params.outdir}/CircRNACount
        cp {input.linear_count} {params.outdir}/LinearCount
        cp {input.coordinates} {params.outdir}/CircCoordinates

        # Drop strand column only in the copy
        awk '{print $1, $2, $3, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10}' OFS="\t" \
            {params.outdir}/CircRNACount > {params.outdir}/CircRNACount.fixed
        mv {params.outdir}/CircRNACount.fixed {params.outdir}/CircRNACount

        circtools detect \
            -T {threads} \
            @{input.samplesheet} \
            -mt1 @{input.mate1} \
            -mt2 @{input.mate2} \
            -B @{input.bamlist} \
            -an {config[reference][gtf]} \
            -Pi -Nr {params.nr1} {params.nr2} \
            -A {config[reference][fasta]} \
            -cq -cql {input.ciriquant_list} \
            -O {params.outdir}

        # Step 2: merge CircRNACount and CircCoordinates
        awk 'BEGIN {FS=OFS="\t"} NR==FNR {key=$1 FS $2 FS $3; gene[$key]=$4; next} \
            FNR==1 {print "Gene", $0; next} \
            {key=$1 FS $2 FS $3; g=(key in gene)?gene[$key]:"not_annotated"; print g, $0}' \
            {params.outdir}/CircCoordinates {output.circ} \
            > {params.outdir}/CircRNACountName_Merged_Normalized.txt
    """)

    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "metatool", "completed")
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, "metatool", "failed")
    raise e

enrichment.name: enrichment
enrichment.condition: ENRICHMENT_GTF and ENRICHMENT_FASTA and ENRICHMENT_PREFIX and REPEATS
enrichment.description: Perform repeat enrichment analysis using circtools enrich module.
enrichment.run:
update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'enrichment', 'running')

try:
    shell("""
        mkdir -p run_output/enrich run_output/enrich/repeats run_output/enrich/output run_output/enrich/global_tmp

        echo "[2/5] Generating genes_and_introns.gtf..."
        bash ../../app/scripts/circtools_generate_intron_gtf.sh {input.gtf} run_output/enrich

        echo "[3/5] Extracting repeats..."
        wget https://links.jakobilab.org/repeat_selection_mm10.tar.bz2 -O repeats.tar.bz2
        tar --strip-components=1 -jxvf repeats.tar.bz2 -C run_output/enrich/repeats
        rm repeats.tar.bz2

        echo "[4/5] Generating flanking introns..."
        ../../app/scripts/circtools_generate_flanking_introns.py \
            -g run_output/enrich/genes_and_introns.gtf \
            -d {input.circ_coords} \
            > run_output/enrich/murine_flanking_introns.bed

        echo "[5/5] Running enrich for repeats..."
        for repeat in {params.repeats}; do
            tmp_dir="run_output/enrich/global_tmp/$repeat"
            mkdir -p "$tmp_dir"
            csv_out="run_output/enrich/output/${repeat}_output_2000_iter.csv"
            log_out="run_output/enrich/output/${repeat}_enrich.log"

            circtools enrich \
                -c run_output/enrich/murine_flanking_introns.bed \
                -b run_output/enrich/repeats/${repeat}.bed \
                -a run_output/enrich/genes_and_introns.gtf \
                -g run_output/enrich/mm10.chrom.sizes \
                -i 2000 -I intron -p {threads} -P 1 -T 1 \
                -o run_output/enrich/output/ \
                -F ${repeat} \
                -t "$tmp_dir" \
                > "$log_out" 2>&1 || true

            [ -f "$csv_out" ] || touch "$csv_out"
        done
    """)

    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'enrichment', 'completed')
except Exception as e:
    update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'enrichment', 'error')
    raise e

primer.name: primer
primer.description: Generate circRNA primer design reports using circtools primex.
primer.run:
update_step_status(EXP_ID, 'primer', 'running')
try:
    shell("""
        mkdir -p run_output/primer_output

        # Filter for this one gene
        awk -F '\t' 'NR==1 || $4 == "{params.gene}"' \
            run_output/circtools_ci/CircCoordinates \
            > run_output/primer_output/CircCoordinates_{params.gene}.txt

        # Run circtools primex for the gene
        circtools primex \
            -d run_output/primer_output/CircCoordinates_{params.gene}.txt \
            -f {input.fasta} \
            -g {input.gtf} \
            -T {params.gene}_primer_report \
            -O mm \
            -o run_output/primer_output/
